name: Heart Over Head
source:
You and a friend decide to attend a music show for a touring artist, who just so happens to be coming to your town! After the opening act ends, an unexpected stranger pushes you to the ground and robs you of one of your belongings. 

Fueled by a need for revenge, you sneak away from your friend to hunt down the mysterious figure and retrieve your items. However, when you discover this unknown person’s dark secret, it becomes much harder to walk away...

[From [url=https://phonyroni.itch.io/heart-over-head]Itch.io[/url]]
